g.text: Top-down coastal island tileset placeholder for a 2D prototype:
16x16 or 24x24 seamless tiles — wet sand, reef rock, grass tuft,
wooden dock planks, brick wall, tide pool, shallow water edge, deep
water, and 8 props (crate, barrel, rock, driftwood, camp tent,
campfire, whale-bone fence, torch). Flat colors with 1px dark
outline, consistent top-left light, muted teal-and-brass palette,
painterly grain. Transparent PNG atlas plus 24px grid reference
Full prompt: Eagle annotation and request.md
